SELECT a.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM activities a WHERE a.created_at >= #{from} AND a.created_at <= #{to}
GROUP BY a.status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS signup_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS distinct_student_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM signups s JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at <= #{to} AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS checkin_count, SUM(CASE WHEN si.source = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_checkin_count, SUM(CASE WHEN si.source IS NULL OR si.source <> 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS supplement_checkin_count FROM signins si JOIN signups s ON s.id = si.signup_id JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE si.created_at >= #{from} AND si.created_at <= #{to} AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at <= #{to} AND s.status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT a.club_id AS club_id, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM activities a WHERE a.created_at >= #{from} AND a.created_at <= #{to}
GROUP BY a.club_id

SELECT a.club_id AS club_id, COUNT(*) AS signup_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM signups s JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at <= #{to} AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY a.club_id

SELECT a.club_id AS club_id, COUNT(*) AS checkin_count FROM signins si JOIN signups s ON s.id = si.signup_id JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE si.created_at >= #{from} AND si.created_at <= #{to} AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at <= #{to} AND s.status = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY a.club_id

SELECT CAST(a.created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM activities a WHERE a.created_at >= #{from} AND a.created_at <= #{to}
GROUP BY CAST(a.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT CAST(s.created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS signup_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM signups s JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at <= #{to} AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY CAST(s.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date
